# Sunmount Solutions Private Limited

> India's indigenous solar PV mounting structure manufacturer. ISO 9001 & TÜV SÜD certified aluminium and steel mounting systems engineered for wind loads up to 200 km/h, supplied across India and 50+ countries. Based in Sirsa, Haryana.

Sunmount (brand name SunMount®) designs and manufactures rooftop solar mounting systems with interactive 3D product models on its website. Product range covers trapezoidal metal roofs, standing-seam roofs, flat/low-pitch roofs, and maintenance walkways.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.sunmount.in/): Company overview, product highlights, certifications, and team.
- [Products](https://www.sunmount.in/products): Full mounting-systems catalogue with interactive 3D models and technical specifications — Mono Rail (65/70/100mm), Mini Rail (70/100mm, Short), Long Rail (Lite/Pro/Ultra), Standing Seam clamps (55/70/100mm), Inclined System, and FRP Walkway. Includes accessories and hardware.
- [Contact](https://www.sunmount.in/contact): Request a quote, sales enquiry form, and headquarters details.
- [Careers](https://www.sunmount.in/careers): Current job openings and online application form.

## Products

- [Mono Rail Solar Mounting Structure](https://www.sunmount.in/products/mono-rail): Mono Rail aluminium solar mounting structure for trapezoidal metal roofs. Four variants, 65–100 mm roof clearance, portrait panels, rated to 200 km/h wind.
- [Mini Rail Solar Mounting Structure](https://www.sunmount.in/products/mini-rail): Mini Rail low-profile aluminium solar mounting for trapezoidal roofs. Landscape panels, 70 mm & 100 mm clearance or Short Rail, rated to 200 km/h.
- [Long Rail Solar Mounting Structure](https://www.sunmount.in/products/long-rail): Long Rail purlin-mounted aluminium solar structure for industrial and asbestos roofs. Ultra, Light & Pro variants, fewer roof punctures, 200 km/h rated.
- [Standing Seam Solar Mounting Clamps](https://www.sunmount.in/products/standing-seam): Standing seam solar clamps that grip the seam with zero roof drilling. 55 mm, 70 mm (Type 1 & 2) and 100 mm Pro variants, rated to 200 km/h wind.
- [FRP Walkway for Solar Rooftops](https://www.sunmount.in/products/frp-walkway): Anti-slip FRP walkway grating for solar rooftop maintenance access. Meniscus top, 38 × 38 mm mesh, UV-stabilised, corrosion-free, 20 & 25 mm heights.
- [Inclined Solar Mounting Structure (5°–20° Tilt)](https://www.sunmount.in/products/inclined): Inclined aluminium solar mounting structure for flat and low-pitch roofs. Adjustable 5°–20° tilt for south-facing panels on metal or asbestos roofs.

## Guides

- [Aluminium vs GI Solar Mounting Structures: Which to Choose](https://www.sunmount.in/blog/aluminium-vs-gi-solar-mounting-structures): Aluminium vs galvanised iron (GI) solar mounting structures compared on weight, corrosion, roof load, installation and lifespan for Indian rooftops.
- [Choosing a Solar Mounting Structure for a Metal (Tin Shed) Roof](https://www.sunmount.in/blog/solar-mounting-structure-for-metal-roof): Mono Rail, Mini Rail or Long Rail? How to pick a solar mounting structure for trapezoidal metal and tin-shed roofs by orientation, clearance and roof type.
- [Solar on Standing Seam Roofs Without Drilling](https://www.sunmount.in/blog/standing-seam-solar-mounting-without-drilling): How standing seam solar clamps grip the roof seam with zero penetration, which clamp fits 55, 70 or 100 mm seams, and what to check before installing.
- [Wind Load and Solar Mounting Structures in India](https://www.sunmount.in/blog/solar-mounting-wind-load-india): What a 200 km/h wind rating means, how IS 875 (Part 3) basic wind speeds apply to rooftop solar in India, and what to ask your mounting supplier.
- [The Future of Solar Is Bright: Rooftop Solar in India](https://www.sunmount.in/blog/the-future-of-solar-is-bright): Why rooftop solar is growing fast in India, what it means for factories, homes and EPC installers, and why the mounting structure decides a system's lifespan.

## FAQ

- [Solar Mounting Structure FAQ](https://www.sunmount.in/faq): Roof compatibility, wind ratings (up to 200 km/h; Inclined System 170 km/h), materials (aluminium 6063 T6, SS 304, EPDM), module fit (30/35/40 mm frames), certifications and ordering.
